production_contract: RawFile is canonical name pointer/intlen/buffer pointer only; disk12/native24. No flags or compressed-length field exists in this type.

Name null consumes0bytes; inlineFFF invokes actual XString null-terminated path; encoded offsets use actual pointer conversion. NameFFFFFFFE is not inline and must be rejected by a bounded adapter unless independently supported.
Any nonzero buffer field is a presence flag. Wrapper replaces it with a fresh block4 byte allocation and reads exactly signed len+1; it does not resolve buffer offsets or requireFFF.
Buffer null consumes0bytes even with a positive declared len. Present len0 reads1byte. Check len+1 overflow before wrapper branch; do not alter the unchanged leaf arithmetic.

Buffer is fixed byte data, not a strlen-driven string. Production does not explicitly validate finalNUL or reject interiorNUL; genuine observed finalNUL is evidence, not a new general format restriction.
Win32 mask0 allocation adds no disk pad. Native allocation aligns at least8; native padding is not read from source and must not be counted as FastFile bytes.

Name and buffer allocations append after first asset children in block4; TEMP header field updates remain live until future successful overwrite. Existing retained old StringTable tail values must stay authoritative.
Selected wrapper does not register a persistent RawFile header or call DB_AddXAsset. Keep TEMP scope explicit, inspect header while live, detach/reset before owner release.
